DISASSEMBLY OF OVERDRIVE PLANETARY GEAR, OVERDRIVE DIRECT CLUTCH AND OVERDRIVE ONE-WAY CLUTCH

1. CHECK OPERATION OF ONE-WAY CLUTCH
Hold the O/D direct clutch drum and turn the input shaft. The input shaft turns freely clockwise and locks counter-clockwise.
